purpose: Repair only the fail-closed raw Yahoo 1H coverage defects from run 34774070956 without changing the frozen V20 signal, ranker, TopN gates, canonical daily eligibility, label endpoint, or opening any H1/H2 outcome.

allowed_inputs: frozen 1810-symbol universe and canonical daily active symbol/date requirements
raw Yahoo 1H bars fetched without strategy-return access

identity_repair.rule: A frozen output symbol may query a predecessor/alias only after the mapping is independently verified from point-in-time identity/listing/code-change evidence. Query identity and output identity must be recorded separately. Never infer an alias from price/return similarity.

sparse_refetch.scope: Only canonical-active frozen-universe symbol/date pairs missing from the original raw panel after approved identity repair.
sparse_refetch.method: Targeted Yahoo 1H refetch with bounded overlap around the missing date; merge only raw source bars belonging to the frozen H1 window.

repair_rules.merge_identity: All repaired rows must be normalized back to the original frozen V20 output symbol; retain query_symbol/source_identity audit fields where applicable.
repair_rules.split_semantics: Yahoo explicit-period split scaling remains allowed only for the already-frozen scale-invariant V20 intraday ratios/quantiles. No absolute intraday-price feature may be introduced. Absolute prior-day gate and canonical 5BD label remain canonical-daily only.
repair_rules.daily_pit_volume_warning: Do not modify V20's already-frozen canonical daily gate inside this repair. The cross-lane PIT daily-volume issue is a promotion-data warning and must be handled under a separately versioned contract rather than silently altering this frozen H1 experiment.

post_acceptance_only.if_any_pass: Only passing policy may proceed to a separately frozen H2 contract using the same TopN.
